prompt_text: Who is the best moving company in Pleasanton CA for a local move?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single “best” mover for everyone — the right company depends on your date, budget, how much you’re moving, and what services you need (packing, stairs, piano, etc.). I can help you choose, but here are practical steps and a few reputable companies to check in Pleasanton / Tri‑Valley:

What to look for
- Licensed & insured: ask for their CA household goods carrier registration and a USDOT number if it’s interstate.  
- Get at least 3 in‑home (or video) estimates — compare binding vs non‑binding and hourly vs flat quotes.  
- Verify recent reviews on Google, Yelp, Angi and the BBB; look for consistent praise about punctuality, care and communication.  
- Ask about insurance options (released value vs full replacement), extra fees (stairs, long carry, elevator, shuttle), and cancellation/deposit policies.  
- Confirm written estimate, inventory list and a bill of lading before moving day.

Companies to consider (start by requesting quotes/reviews)
- Two Men and a Truck (national brand with local Bay Area locations)  
- College HUNKS Hauling Junk & Moving (franchise with Bay Area service)  
- Local Bay Area moving companies (search “Pleasanton movers” on Google/Yelp to find well‑rated independent firms)

How I can help
- If you tell me move date, home sizes (studio/2BR/4BR), and services needed (packing, piano, storage), I can list 4–6 locally rated movers to get quotes from and sample questions to ask them.

Want me to help shortlist movers for your specific move? If so, give date, current & destination zip codes, and a quick inventory.
